testCases.title: Web wallet from the registry
testCases.summary: EHR loads the registry, the tester picks a web wallet, shares everything.

ehr: Response opens and verifies (§8.5, §8.6)
Passes cross-validation (§6.4)
Shows each item's status and data
wallet: Shows the EHR origin during consent
Returned resources carry the matching US Core meta.profile

testCases.title: Native wallet through the Digital Credentials API
testCases.summary: Same as M1 through navigator.credentials.get.

ehr: Response opens and verifies
Passes cross-validation
Shows each item's status and data
wallet: Returned resources carry the matching US Core meta.profile

testCases.title: Insurance
testCases.summary: Demographics and insurance, as CARIN or US Core coverage, FHIR JSON or SMART Health Card.

ehr: Displays member, payer, and plan
Verifies a SMART Health Card signature before showing it
wallet: Returns Coverage with a requested profile in an accepted media type

testCases.title: Pre-visit questionnaire, inline
testCases.summary: PHQ-2 sent inline.

ehr: Shows each answer next to its question
wallet: QuestionnaireResponse.questionnaire equals the requested canonical exactly

testCases.title: One item declined
testCases.summary: Tester declines immunizations and shares the rest.

ehr: Shows the declined item as declined, not an error

testCases.title: Nothing to share
testCases.summary: Tester declines the whole request, or the wallet has no coverage.

ehr: Handles a whole-request decline
Handles an unavailable item
Patient can continue without the wallet
wallet: Returns unavailable for an item it cannot fulfill, or declined outcome

testCases.title: Anything in USCDI, small patient
testCases.summary: A modest record under 512 KB.

ehr: Shows every returned resource under uscdi
wallet: Lets the patient choose what to include

testCases.title: Anything in USCDI, large patient
testCases.summary: A full record well over 512 KB.

ehr: Response arrives intact

testCases.title: Questionnaire by reference only
testCases.summary: GAD-7 by canonical, no inline body.

ehr: Shows the answers
wallet: Fetches and renders the form, or reports unsupported

testCases.title: Versioned canonical
testCases.summary: PHQ-2 with a |1 version suffix, body inline.

ehr: Shows the answers

testCases.title: Physician-authored form
testCases.summary: The semaglutide check-in form, inline.

ehr: Shows every answer, including typed pen-trouble answers
wallet: Shows conditional items only when their conditions are met

testCases.title: Narrowed family
testCases.summary: US Core family narrowed to Observation.

ehr: Shows the Observations

testCases.title: No selector
testCases.summary: Whatever the patient thinks is relevant.

ehr: Displays whatever arrives

testCases.title: SMART Health Card
testCases.summary: Immunizations, SMART Health Card preferred.

ehr: Verifies the card's signature and shows its contents

testCases.title: One artifact, several items
testCases.summary: Wallet answers allergies and medications with one Bundle.

ehr: Attributes the resources to both items without double-counting
wallet: One artifact's fulfills lists both items

testCases.title: Cross-device
testCases.summary: Desktop browser shows a QR code; the phone's wallet answers.

ehr: Response arrives in the desktop page

testCases.title: In-person handoff
testCases.summary: A QR code or kiosk lands the patient's phone on the check-in page.

ehr: Same as M2, with the handoff shown

testCases.title: Prefilled form
testCases.summary: Wallet prefills what it can and lets the patient edit.

ehr: Shows the answers
wallet: Prefilled answers are visible before sending

testCases.title: Write back
testCases.summary: EHR files returned data after staff review.

ehr: Staff can accept or reject each item

testCases.title: Unknown selector
testCases.summary: An item with an undefined selector kind.

ehr: Shows the unsupported item as unsupported
wallet: Reports unsupported for that item and answers the others
